_comment_version: Do not change the version number! It is used for automatic config updates.
_comment_blacklists: Add mod IDs, category names (e.g. ambient, misc), or mob IDs here to hide them from the Bestiary.
_comment_category_overrides: Force an entire mod or specific mobs into a specific category tab ('monsters', 'creatures', 'bosses').
_comment_custom_actions: Manually add required actions to specific mobs. Valid actions: kill, breed, tame, shear, bucket, trade, ride, interact
